notes: Phase 1 candidate local components. Status 'candidate' means the component loads and runs in the harness; it is not selected for release until its quality is measured on representative data. Measured timings live in research/results, not here.

components.execution: WebAssembly in a dedicated worker; code served from the app origin
components.geometry: word and line axis-aligned boxes in input pixels

components.model: deterministic value patterns and field labels
components.limits: Unlabelled names and addresses are not detected by this component

components.execution: WebGPU (fp32) or WASM (q8); ONNX Runtime WASM served from the app origin
components.labels: CoNLL-03 PER, LOC, ORG, MISC; PER and LOC mapped to person_name and postal_address
components.limits: Trained on news text; recall on labels and documents unmeasured

components.execution: MediaPipe WASM with GPU or CPU delegate; WASM served from the app origin
components.limits: Short-range model intended for faces near the camera; small background faces likely missed. Accuracy on consented photographs unmeasured

components.model: rule-based intent schema plus OCR anchor/value matching

components.license: Apache-2.0 upstream (google/owlvit-base-patch32); the ONNX repository card declares no license, so verify before release
components.limits: Open-vocabulary object boxes; not designed to localise individual text fields

components.model: HTMLCanvasElement.toBlob('image/png') on a fresh opaque canvas
components.checks: PNG chunk allowlist, dimensions, full opacity, exact mask colour on re-decoded pixels

deferred.reason: OCR boxes and conservative face boxes suffice for the Phase 1 categories; SAM-family models stay optional
No browser code detector integrated yet; codes are not a supported category
